introduction.heading: About
zh: 3 年+产品、工业与包装设计经验，聚焦美妆个护包装、品牌产品设计与结构落地。
WWP Beauty 期间参与 30+ 项目，并在 15+ 项目中承担项目管理职责，具备从需求拆解、概念与 CMF、结构协同、打样测试到量产交付的完整经验；在 HEAVEN PINK 形成品牌产品语言、系列视觉统筹及产品—包装—上市视觉协同能力，并持续探索 AI 在概念生成、方案表达与设计提效中的应用。
en: 3+ years of experience across product, industrial and packaging design, with a focus on beauty and personal-care packaging, branded product design and production-ready development.

At WWP Beauty, I contributed to 30+ projects and took on project-management responsibilities in 15+, building end-to-end experience from brief definition, concept and CMF through structural collaboration, prototyping, testing and mass-production delivery. At HEAVEN PINK, I developed brand product language, coordinated series-level visual systems and connected product, packaging and launch visuals, while continuing to explore AI for concept generation, design communication and workflow efficiency.

highlights.title: 产品设计体系
highlights.zh: 梳理 HEAVEN PINK 产品语言，以克制配色、秩序化装饰与一致性细节建立系列识别，统筹产品、包装与上市视觉。
highlights.en: Defined the HEAVEN PINK product language through restrained colour, ordered decoration and consistent detailing, coordinating product, packaging and launch visuals across the range.

highlights.title: 冰熨斗妆前精华乳
highlights.zh: 负责前期产品方案与打样，建立主视觉及造型方向；项目移交后，后续设计沿用该视觉体系持续调整。
highlights.en: Led early product concepts and prototyping, establishing the primary visual and form direction that continued to guide later design development after handover.

highlights.title: 轻润柔雾多用棒
highlights.zh: 完成产品外观、CMF 与包装方案，经多轮打样确认开模方案，推进测试样及大货落地。
highlights.en: Completed the product form, CMF and packaging proposal, confirming the tooling direction through multiple prototype rounds and advancing test samples into mass production.

highlights.title: 面部综合盘
highlights.zh: 负责外观与内盘开模方案，完成配套包装设计；经多轮打样确认开模方案，并推进测试样及大货落地。
highlights.en: Developed the exterior and inner-pan tooling scheme and supporting packaging, validating the final direction through repeated sampling and production follow-up.

highlights.title: 包装设计与项目推进
highlights.zh: 服务至本、且初、DDG、安利、Rare Beauty、Haus Labs、HOURGLASS 等品牌，覆盖需求拆解、趋势与竞品研究、概念及 CMF 提案、结构协同、样品验证、开模跟进与量产交付；参与 30+ 项目，并在 15+ 项目中承担项目管理职责。
highlights.en: Worked across ZHIBEN, KIMTRUE, DDG, Amway, Rare Beauty, Haus Labs, HOURGLASS and other brands, covering brief definition, trend and competitor research, concept and CMF proposals, structural collaboration, sample validation, tooling follow-up and production delivery. Contributed to 30+ projects and held project-management responsibilities in 15+.

highlights.title: Rare Beauty Positive Light Under Eye Brightener
highlights.titleEn: Rare Beauty Positive Light Under Eye Brightener
highlights.zh: 参与冷触金属涂抹头及整体包装的造型调整，协同优化盖体、涂抹头与瓶身比例；产品获 Allure 最佳包装设计奖。
highlights.en: Contributed to form refinement for the cooling metal applicator and overall pack, collaborating on the proportions between cap, applicator and bottle. The product received an Allure Best of Beauty Packaging award.

highlights.title: HOURGLASS Phantom Liquid Eyeshadow
highlights.zh: 输出 5 套设计方案，涵盖 applicator 探索与整体造型调整；三款入选造型经两轮打样后确认开模方案并落地。
highlights.en: Developed five design directions spanning applicator exploration and overall form refinement. Three selected forms were validated over two sample rounds before tooling and production.

highlights.title: Schwan Match&Play Facestick
highlights.zh: 输出多套 4.5 g 多用棒方案，基于公模进行产品造型与功能调整，以降低开模成本；经多轮打样确认开模方案。
highlights.en: Created multiple 4.5 g multi-use stick concepts, adapting form and function around an existing mould to reduce tooling cost and confirming the final direction through repeated sampling.

highlights.title: 量产与创新成果
highlights.zh: 为 Rare Beauty 输出多项设计方案，并推动 Rare Beginnings Eau de Parfum Travel Spray 项目落地；参与 MUZIGAE MANSION Objet Liquid、Tie Up Cover Tint 外形调整，以及至本特安修护精华、且初二代卸妆膏包装升级。相关产品好评率提升 15%，累计申请 5+ 项专利、开发 3+ 套新公模。
highlights.en: Developed multiple proposals for Rare Beauty and helped deliver the Rare Beginnings Eau de Parfum Travel Spray. Contributed to form refinements for MUZIGAE MANSION Objet Liquid and Tie Up Cover Tint, as well as packaging upgrades for ZHIBEN repair serum and KIMTRUE cleansing balm. Related products achieved a 15% increase in positive reviews, alongside 5+ patent applications and 3+ newly developed public moulds.

highlights.title: 唱片与视觉系统
highlights.zh: 从实习协作成长为独立项目负责人，完成 10+ 专辑及周边项目；负责封面、内页、唱片包装、宣传物料、海报／KV 与陈列延展。熟悉印刷、光盘与特殊材料工艺，并完成条码版权信息、成本及供应商校验，保障成品出版交付。
highlights.en: Progressed from internship support to independent project ownership across 10+ album and merchandise projects, covering covers, editorial pages, physical-media packaging, promotional materials, posters, key visuals and display extensions. Managed print, disc and specialist-material processes together with barcode, copyright, cost and supplier checks to ensure final publication delivery.

recognition.zh: 面向 SDGs 的农业包装再利用基础鞋履方案，聚焦可持续设计。
recognition.en: A sustainable footwear concept aligned with the SDGs, exploring the reuse of agricultural packaging materials.
